behavior: Enter the original visible operands; no numerical prefill or main-answer transfer.
Addition and subtraction: enter decimal-place count, place-value multiplier, moved operands, whole-number operation and moved-back result.

Division by decimals moves both operands equally. Division by a whole number moves the dividend and then restores the quotient.
Place-value instruction uses 10/100 and zero-place multiplier 1 rather than requiring exponent terminology.
